sections.heading: Then shape the material
sections.body: Each medium behaves differently. Texture work needs depth, embroidery needs balance, and decor work needs structure, finish, and presentation.

articles.title: How to care for handmade pieces
articles.excerpt: Simple care habits for storing, gifting, and displaying handcrafted decor, textile detail, and keepsakes.

sections.heading: Keep it dry and supported
sections.body: Store delicate pieces away from moisture and pressure. Use a flat surface or protective box for decor and keepsakes.

sections.heading: Handle details gently
sections.body: Small decorative elements can be strong but still need careful handling, especially during gifting, packing, or event setup.

sections.heading: Make presentation part of the piece
sections.body: A handmade gift feels more complete when the finishing, note, packaging, and reveal all feel intentional.

sections.heading: Choose by purpose

items.question: Can I request a fully custom piece?
items.answer: Yes. Share the occasion, medium, size, colors, timeline, and any references so Meraki Arts 53 can shape a clear direction.

items.question: Can the same idea work across different materials?
items.answer: Yes. An idea can be translated across texture art, textile detail, decor, paintings, and custom gifting when the material is suitable.

items.question: Do I need a complete idea before reaching out?
items.answer: No. A few details are enough to begin. Meraki Arts 53 can help refine the concept before confirming the final direction.
